typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk - Use font-black for main headers, tight tracking (tracking-tighter).
typography.body: Satoshi - Clean geometric sans for UI text, labels.
typography.numbers_and_data: JetBrains Mono - For all financial values, dates, IDs, and tabular data.
typography.anti_pattern: BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk. No emoji usage.

scales.spacing: Base 4px. Standardize inner padding for cards to p-6 or p-8. Use gap-6 for grids. Avoid cramped p-4.
scales.radius: Strict System: rounded-none for minimal inputs, rounded-xl for all main cards/modals, rounded-md for small buttons. NO MIXING rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl.

visual enhancers.elevation: No flat gray shadows. Use 1px inner borders (ring-1 ring-white/5). Modals get shadow-[0_32px_64px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)].
visual enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY on sticky elements like Filter Bar: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#060907]/80.
visual enhancers.borders: Expose skeleton on table views. border-b border-white/5 for rows.

grids.kpi_summary: High Density Bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Highlight 'Total a Receber' with a subtle primary gradient border. Values in JetBrains Mono.
grids.general: Direct children only for grids. Use align-items: start.

layouts.page_structure: Left-align typography. Asymmetric tension. Leave negative space.
layouts.tabs: Cardless layout. Subtle underline or animated pill background for active state. No bulky block tabs.
layouts.history_table: Dense data view. JetBrains Mono for amounts. Remove vertical borders. Subtle border-b on rows.
layouts.parcela_row: Grid layout. Date/Name (left), Status (center), Amount/Actions (right). Vertical optical centering.

component_instructions.filters_bar: Sticky top with glassmorphism. Inputs should be minimal: pure dark background, bottom border only.
component_instructions.bulk_actions_bar: Floating pill at bottom center. bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-lg backdrop-blur-md.
component_instructions.client_group_header: High contrast minimal header. text-lg text-white font-bold, no badges. Sub-label for loan count.
component_instructions.loan_header: 2px thin progress bar. Remove bulky badges. 'Cobrar tudo' as subtle text-link.
component_instructions.parcela_row: Kill card styling. Flat grid row (grid-cols-12). Col 1-4: Date/Parcela. Col 5-7: Status Dot + text. Col 8-10: Value (JetBrains Mono). Col 11-12: Actions.
component_instructions.confirmation_cards: Minimal toast via Sonner. Green stroke, dark bg. No emojis.
component_instructions.empty_states: Sleek low-opacity Lucide icon (Ghost/Inbox) + sharp reassuring message in Cabinet Grotesk.
component_instructions.detail_modal: Rocket Money style in Dark Mode. Width: max-w-4xl. 2 Columns. Left: Huge Amount (JetBrains Mono text-6xl), Date, Notes. Right: 'ACTIONS' list for Method, Date Picker, Registrar button. Divider border-r border-white/10.

ai_slop_removal_checklist: EMOJIS: Remove every single emoji (📅 🔥 ⏰ ⚠️ ⏳ 💰 📈 📊 ✅ 🔄 📋 📥 👤) from the codebase and replace with lucide-react components (Calendar, AlertCircle, Clock, etc).
BADGE SOUP: Delete stacked <Badge> components in rows. Replace with a single 6px colored dot (e.g., bg-red-500) and plain text.
MUDDY SURFACES: Remove `bg-muted` and `bg-slate-800` spam. Replace with precise `#0A100C` backgrounds and `ring-1 ring-white/5`.
INCONSISTENT RADII: Find all `rounded-2xl/3xl/lg` and enforce `rounded-xl` for containers, `rounded-md` for inputs/buttons.
CENTER-DISEASE: Search for `text-center`, `items-center` on block containers and remove them. Left-align typography, right-align numeric amounts.
GENERIC FONTS: Remove `Inter`, `Roboto` from Tailwind config. Inject `Cabinet Grotesk`, `Satoshi`, and `JetBrains Mono`.

motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-[1px] and border brightness shift on cards.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up (Framer Motion) for lists and ParcelaRow items.
motion.interactions: Number count-up for KPI values. Status transitions using LayoutGroup.

accessibility.contrast: APCA preferred. Minimum 4.5:1 for small text.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, links, form inputs, menus, and rows.

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for this specific dense data view. Keep it focused on fast 2D rendering.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. ELIMINATE ALL EMOJIS in /pagamentos. Map to lucide-react.
2. KILL BADGE SOUP. Use single status dots and plain text.
3. UPDATE FONTS. Add Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi, and JetBrains Mono.
4. REDESIGN ParcelaRow into a sleek list item with grid alignment.
5. ROCKET MONEY MODAL ADAPTATION. 2-column layout. Left: Large amount/date. Right: ACTIONS list. Dark Kredor theme.
6. FLATTEN KPI CARDS. Remove bulky shadows. Use border-white/5.
7. Standardize radii to rounded-xl for main cards, rounded-md for inner elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center align app containers. Use glassmorphism cautiously over dark backgrounds. Never use 'transition: all'. Apply distinct hover/active states with higher contrast. Do not use AI assistant emojis. Create depth via layered z-index borders. Do not use transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.
